The three authoring forms of an annexe, in the order they must share a counter.

```{r}
#| label: tbl-anx-demo
#| tbl-cap: "A table annexe."

data.frame(a = 1:2, b = c("x", "y"))
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-anx-plot
#| fig-cap: "A figure annexe."
#| fig-height: 2

plot(1:10)
```

::: {#anx-manual}
Content that is neither a table nor a figure.

A hand-written annexe.
:::

Reference: @anx-demo.
